title: Rust DAO Transit emits and accepts obsolete E=1 parent encoding
description: lichen-rpl routing emits Transit path_control 0x80 and parser explicitly accepts E=0 or E=1, but canonical current profile requires E=0 for the exact 20-byte parent form; option length conveys Parent presence. E=0x80 is an unsupported negative and reserved 0x40 must also fail. Update production DAO generation/parser and exact vector/negative tests.
